name: create-task
description: Creates a HubSpot task (a to-do, call or email reminder) with a subject, due date, priority and optional owner (an id from hubspot__list-owners), optionally on a contact, company or deal (the record id from hubspot__find-contact, hubspot__find-deal or hubspot__get-record).

ownerId.description: The owner id to assign the task to, from hubspot__list-owners.

recordId.description: The record's id: a contact's from hubspot__find-contact, a deal's from hubspot__find-deal, a company's from the associations hubspot__get-record answers.
